text:
Maya (Marketing): Hey team — final draft is in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1X... please do a quick QA + approvals. Target publish Wed 9am PT. Drop :eyes: on anything blocking. cc @Rajat
Tom (Product): Thanks — small nit: change heading 'Reduce inference costs' -> 'Lower inference costs' — reads cleaner.
Elaine (Eng): Spotted an accuracy claim in para 3: '12x cost reduction' — what's the source for that? Need either a citation or change to 'up to 12x'.
Maya (Marketing): Good catch — data is in the benchmarks section (figshare link in doc). I'll swap to 'up to 12x' unless @Rajat requests otherwise.
Rajat (Legal): Please change to 'up to 12x' + add parenthetical: '(results from internal benchmark on NVIDIA A100, 16k context)'. Also avoid naming customers. Otherwise ok from legal. /Rajat
Sam (Sales): For SDR handoff — can we add a short 'how to pitch' snippet? 2 bullets: pain + 1-liner value prop. I can draft by EOD.
Maya (Marketing): Adding SDR snippet now. Also CTA decision: 'Request a demo' vs 'Try the hosted API' — which do we want?
Tom (Product): For PLG we love 'Try the hosted API' but for enterprise targeted launch, 'Request a demo' converts better. Could do split CTAs: top banner demo, inline try API.
Elaine (Eng): Tech note: the embedding example uses old SDK import (v0.2). I'll update to v0.5 snippet. Also suggested adding a streaming example but we can link to docs to save space.
Maya (Marketing): Great — Elaine, please update the code snippet in the doc. I'll keep streaming as 'See docs' so the post stays concise.
PublishBot: Publish checklist status: assets, hero image, GA tags, og:image, hubspot form. Missing: hero image alt text, PR link, and legal sign-off.
Rajat (Legal): Signed off if you change to 'up to' and remove a SOC2 implication in para 5. I left a comment.
Maya (Marketing): Done — swapped to 'up to 12x' and removed SOC2 wording per your comment. @Sam please confirm the SDR snippet when you add it.
Sam (Sales): Posted 2-bullet pitch + 3 sample email subject lines in the doc. Looks good to me :thumbsup:
Tom (Product): Timeline check: draft closes today 5pm PT, final approvals by 6pm, publish Wed 9am PT. Ops needs to queue deploy.
PublishBot: Publish slot requested: Wed 09:00 PT. Pending ops confirmation. @Elaine please confirm CDN cache invalidation window.
Elaine (Eng): CDN window is clear. I'll run cache purge at 09:05 PT. Ops good to deploy.
Maya (Marketing): Perfect — merging remaining comments and will tag final version with ID 1780456200 in the doc. Any objections to the publish time? If none I'll mark approved.
Rajat (Legal): No objections, approved.
Tom (Product): Approved.
Sam (Sales): Approved.
Maya (Marketing): Sweet — scheduling now. :rocket:
